display_name: 源域可信度门控输出诊断
description: 冻结训练完成的信号门控，检查源 pilot 的门控幅度与配对波形误差，不读取 TX 或目标。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

data.version: 672 previously explored source pilot records, epoch19 paired IQ
data.representation: source L_s/U_s received and clean IQ; no transmitter truth

data.physical_ids_ref: 672 source pilot records disjoint from candidate fit IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ only, transmitter truth not read
roles.U_s: source IQ only, transmitter truth hidden

data.validation_ref: Frozen DURA real-source smoke and finite source waveform metrics
data.leo_config_ref: fixed source epoch19 seven simulated views

permissions.claim_scope: Source waveform diagnostic only; no TX accuracy, target evaluation, selection or deployment claim
